correctness.rationale: Flow decomposition and zero-one extremality establish the vertex set; strict convexity reduces all extrema to vertices. Inserting missing union vertices and removing adjacent common vertices strictly increase squared distance, so the maximum reduces to a maximum independent set on an induced path; the parity-dependent count follows from maximal independent supports and label quotient. Boundary orders 3 and 4 checked explicitly; exact checker exhausts 2,794,155 pairs for orders 3 through 13.
